title: Coalgebra measurings, cyclic theory and homologies of matrix algebras
summary: In this paper, we consider coalgebra measurings and the maps induced by them between Hochschild and cyclic homology of algebras. We show that these induced maps are well behaved with respect to the various structures appearing on Hochschild and cyclic homology, such as the $λ$-decomposition, the product structure, as well as the module structure of Hochschild homology over cyclic homology. Thereafter, we relate the maps between homology theories of algebras induced by a coalgebra measuring to those induced between homologies of matrix algebras.
